description.text: Objectives The graduate program in Materials Science and Engineering aims to provide solid theory and systematic technological knowledge to our students so that they will be able to engage in high level teaching and researching in the field of Materials Science and Engineering, and assume leadership role in their future work. We encourage our students to be independent, innovative, and socially responsible with good professional ethics. Duration Duration of the program is between 1.5 to 2 years with course works in the first year, followed by a thesis project. Research Areas 1. Information Functional Materials 2. Advanced Energy Materials 3. Biomaterials 4. Electronic Packaging 5. Nanomaterials Credit Units Students need to successfully complete at least 29 credits with 16 credits for degree courses. Scholarships 1.The Shenzhen Universiade International Scholarship 2.HITSZ Scholarship

duration.text: The Materials Science and Engineering at Harbin Institute of Technology is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4861 USD/per year ￥ 35000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. HITSZ International Student Application Form 2. Highest degree (notarized photocopy) 3. Academic transcripts (notarized photocopy) 4. A study plan (no less than 800 words) 5. Three recommendation letters 6. Photocopy of your Identification Certificate 7. Three passport photos

requirements.text: 1. Aged 18 or above 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health. 3. Hold a Bachelor's degree.
